reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds agent tools for sending task notifications to WeChat and completing local ClawBot login, making notifications and monitoring its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供通过本机 ClawBot 微信通道发送通知及完成扫码登录的工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with tools to send notifications through a locally configured ClawBot WeChat channel and complete QR-code login.

capabilities: Sends agent-generated messages to the user's WeChat through a locally configured ClawBot CLI
Provides QR-code login and login confirmation tools for the local WeChat channel
Uses temporary UTF-8 files to pass notification content to the local sender
